item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 12/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A dry replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China early next week. The weather will be fine and windier over the region. Besides, a broad trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the central part of the South China Sea next week.
